text:
Alex K: Heads-up — running into a few dead image links in the runtime guide after the CDN sweep. Can we rehost or swap to shortlinks?
Priya R: Which images exactly? paste the broken urls pls.
Alex K: /docs/runtime/latency/fig-queue.png and /docs/runtime/kernels/kv-cache-diagram.svg — 404 on both from staging preview.
Maya L: I can rehost them to our S3 bucket. Do we want s3://redwood-docs-prod or keep assets.redwood.ai origin?
Sam T: Prefer s3 canonical + shortlink (so we can rotate origins later). +1 on adding alt text.
Priya R: SGTM. Also found a stale anchor `#batching-tuning` on the same page that should redirect to `#batching-config`.
Alex K: I'll open a small PR: will (1) upload images to s3, (2) update frontmatter paths, (3) add redirect rule in runtime-routes.yaml, and (4) sed-fix the anchor.
Alex K: example sed I plan to run:
```
sed -i 's|/docs/runtime/latency/fig-queue.png|https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-docs/fig-queue.png|' runtime/*.md
```
Priya R: Nice. Can you also add short alt text and a one-line caption for each image? Accessibility wants concise alt + caption.
Maya L: I'll draft alt text. Example: `alt="Request queue visualization showing batching windows"`. Will push to the same branch.
Sam T: I'll take ownership of the PR review and CODEOWNERS change. @Priya R — do you want notification on runtime changes?
Priya R: Yes please, add me to CODEOWNERS for docs/runtime so I get review pings.
Sam T: Will add CODEOWNERS update in the PR.
DocsBot: build started for branch alex/runtime-image-fix (preview URL will follow) :construction:
Alex K: pushed initial commits (upload + frontmatter updates) — https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/754
DocsBot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-754--docs.redwood.ai (screenshot jobs queued)
Sam T: Reviewing the PR now. Quick note: keep filenames lowercase and no spaces.
Maya L: Uploaded assets to s3 and updated the markdown to use shortlinks. Pushed alt texts and captions.
Alex K: added a tiny redirect entry to runtime-routes.yaml and adjusted the anchor in the md. CI flagged a flaky screenshot test, rerunning.
DocsBot: screenshot job retried and passed :white_check_mark:
Sam T: LGTM aside from one nit on caption spacing, leaving a comment in PR.
Priya R: Thanks — once merged could you also add me to the docs runtime Slack watcher? I'd like quick heads-ups for similar regressions.
Sam T: Done — added you to CODEOWNERS and to the channel watcher config in the repo.
Alex K: PR merged and deployed. Runtime page renders correctly with new images and redirect. Closing out. Thanks all! :tada:
